Senses.Explanation: Literally, 'stability' (定) and 'discernment' (慧). The compound occurs 962 times in 196 allowed texts. Huineng devotes a named section to it and gives the richest direct relation: 'Stability and discernment are one body, not two. Stability is the substance of discernment; discernment is the function of stability' (定慧一體，不是二。定是慧體，慧是定用). He continues, 'At the time of discernment, stability is in discernment; at the time of stability, discernment is in stability' (即慧之時定在慧，即定之時慧在定), then names this 'equal learning in stability and discernment.' He explicitly rejects making them successive: 'Do not say first stability produces discernment or first discernment produces stability as separate' (莫言先定發慧、先慧發定各別), and compares their relation to lamp and light—two names whose substance is one. An independent lamp text gives a water-and-wave formulation: 'Stability is substance, discernment is function; from stability discernment arises, from discernment one returns to stability; like water and wave, one body with no before or after' (定是體慧是用從定起慧從慧歸定如水與波一體更無前後). Huangbo answers a question about their equal learning with 'throughout the twelve periods, do not rely on a single thing' (十二時中不依倚一物). A later letter supplies a corrective naming statement: 'Provisionally it is called stability and discernment; it is not an actual thing. As for this mind, it is originally self-stable and self-discerning' (方便喚作定慧，不是實法也。若論此心，本來自定自慧). Another record directly describes the graphs: inner and outer wholly clear is called stability, while responding to conditions and things with function without end is called discernment. The entry reports these corpus definitions without recasting the pair as a staged regimen.
Senses.Note: Direct definitions, substance/function equations, order contrasts, analogies, and corrective witnesses were all harvested. 'Equal stability and discernment' (定慧等) occurs 80 times in 44 texts; 'stability and discernment are one body' occurs in two independent texts; the substance/function formulas occur in four each. The pair remains one corpus-wide sense, led by Huineng's explicit rejection of separation and sequence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 我此法門，以定慧為本。大眾！勿迷，言定慧別。定慧一體，不是二。定是慧體，慧是定用。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Platform Record, section four. Huineng directly states the one-body and substance/function relation of stability and discernment.

Occurrences.Kwic: 即慧之時定在慧，即定之時慧在定。若識此義，即是定慧等學。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Huineng continues the direct equation and names it equal learning in stability and discernment.

Occurrences.Kwic: 諸學道人，莫言先定發慧、先慧發定各別。作此見者，法有二相。口說善語，心中不善。空有定慧，定慧不等。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Huineng explicitly rejects treating stability and discernment as separate sequential productions.

Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問如何是定慧等學師曰定是體慧是用從定起慧從慧歸定如水與波一體更無前後名定慧等學
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Transmission of the Lamp's Finest Flowers preserves a direct question and a water-and-wave answer. The mixed collection heading does not provide a safe speaker link.

Occurrences.Kwic: 師又別時問黃檗。定慧等學此理如何。黃檗云。十二時中不依倚一物。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Record of the Transmission of the Lamp narrates Nanquan asking Huangbo about equal learning in stability and discernment. As a two-speaker case, MasterName is null.

Occurrences.Kwic: 方便喚作定慧，不是實法也。若論此心，本來自定自慧。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Zongbao Daodu's letter to Layman Weng calls the pair a provisional name rather than an actual thing and says mind is originally self-stable and self-discerning. No roster link was asserted.

Occurrences.Kwic: 夫戒定慧者，乃法中之妙用也。佛祖雖嘗有言，而未達者有所執。今略而言之，庶資開悟。然其心境兩忘，一念不動曰戒。覺性圓明，內外瑩徹曰定。隨緣應物，妙用無窮曰慧。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Selected Recorded Sayings, Explanation of Precept-Stability-Discernment. The prose directly assigns separate predicates to stability and discernment; it is not linked to a roster master.
